question: How long does it take to set up Zaina?
answer: It depends on how much there is to load: your catalogue, prices and policies. Tell us about your business on WhatsApp at +254 707 255 598 and the team will give you a date. We don't promise a fixed number of days before seeing what you have.

question: Do I need a website to use Zaina?
answer: No. Every business gets its own page and QR code: print the code as a poster, a table card or a sticker, and customers who scan it chat with Zaina straight away. She can also work on your WhatsApp number. If you have a website, the chat is added with one line of code. If you want a website, the studio builds those too.

question: Will Zaina work on my WordPress, Shopify or Wix site?
answer: Yes. The chat is one script tag, which those platforms and custom-built sites all accept. We install it for you as part of set-up.

question: How is Zaina different from a general chatbot or an auto-reply?
answer: A general chatbot or auto-reply knows nothing about your prices, your rooms or your calendar, can't take a booking or a payment for your business, and your team never hears about the conversation. Zaina works for your business only: she answers from your own information, never invents a price, checks your up-to-date calendar, recommends what suits each customer from what you sell, makes the booking, and passes every lead to your team.

question: Is Zaina smart, or does she just follow a script?
answer: She is not a script. Zaina understands what each customer is really after, asks a short question when a detail is missing, recommends the option that suits them, and always offers a next step. What she never does is make things up: every fact, price and time comes from your business's own information.

question: Does Zaina hand chats over to my WhatsApp?
answer: When a customer needs a person, Zaina alerts your team on their phones (and by email) and hands over the whole conversation in your dashboard, with the customer's details. If the customer is chatting on your WhatsApp number, your team's replies from the dashboard reach them on WhatsApp.

question: Does Zaina make things up or invent prices?
answer: No. Zaina answers only from the information your business gives her, and every price she quotes comes straight from your price list. If something is not in your information, she says so and brings in your team instead of guessing.

question: How does Zaina know what is available?
answer: She checks your up-to-date calendar before offering a time or date. When you or your team update the calendar or prices in the dashboard, Zaina uses the new information straight away, and a connected calendar such as Google Calendar is synced every few minutes.

question: Can Zaina help my customers choose and book?
answer: Yes. She helps each customer find the option that suits them, suggests extras you really offer when they fit, and on the Full plan works out the exact total from your rates, creates the booking and sends the M-Pesa or card checkout.

question: How do I pay for Zaina?
answer: By M-Pesa or card. Monthly plan invoices are paid from your dashboard, and set-up or project invoices at https://bilamatata.com/pay with your invoice reference.

question: Can my staff take over a conversation?
answer: Yes. Your team sees every conversation in the dashboard, gets an alert when a customer needs a person, and can take over any chat. Zaina steps back while a person is replying.

question: What languages does Zaina speak?
answer: English and Swahili. She replies in the language the customer writes in.

question: Where does my customers' money go?
answer: Straight into your own payment account: the M-Pesa or card payment account you connect. Bila Matata does not hold your customers' payments.

question: What happens if Zaina doesn't know an answer?
answer: She says so, offers to take the customer's details, and alerts your team. Zaina does not guess: she answers only from your business's own information.

question: Can I cancel Zaina?
answer: Yes, at any time. Your plan runs to the end of the month you have paid for and then stops. There is no cancellation fee.

question: Do you work with clients outside Kenya?
answer: Yes. We work with businesses in every part of Kenya and with clients abroad. Set-up is done remotely: a call, your price list or menu and your logo, and we do the rest. Card payments work from anywhere.

question: How do I get a quote for a website, app, automation, data or research project?
answer: Tell us what you need on WhatsApp at +254 707 255 598, or leave your name, number and a short description in this chat and the team will contact you. Quotes are free and in writing.

question: Is my data safe?
answer: Each business's conversations, leads and bookings are kept separate from every other business's. Data is encrypted in transit, and conversations are deleted after the retention period. We handle personal data under Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019. Details are at https://bilamatata.com/terms

question: Who is Zaina? Is she a real person?
answer: Zaina is a digital team member: she is an AI, and she never pretends otherwise. From the day she starts with your business she works as one of your team, with a role such as guest experience host or client care host, speaks as "we", and uses your business's own information. If a customer sincerely asks whether they are talking to a person, she says so honestly and the people on your team are right behind her.

question: Can we choose who gets the notification emails?
answer: Yes. In your dashboard, under Settings and Notifications, the owner or a manager adds the email addresses that should be told when a customer is waiting for a person, wants a callback, leaves their details or books. For each address you choose whether it gets alerts with a link to take over the chat, the written-out conversation, or both. Starter allows up to 2 addresses and Full allows up to 5.

question: Does Zaina work for hotels, lodges and other places to stay?
answer: Yes, they are one of the businesses she is built for. On the Full plan she checks your up-to-date calendar, quotes the exact total from your own rates, holds the room, sends your own payment link so the deposit is paid straight to you, and offers the nearest available option when the dates a guest wants are taken. The example conversations on our home page show a stay being booked and a sold-out date being turned into a booking.

question: Does Zaina collect payments for my business?
answer: No. Zaina is your receptionist, not your cashier: she never collects or holds money. When a deposit or payment is due, she sends your customer your own payment link (your M-Pesa or card payment account), and the money goes straight to you. She never asks customers for card numbers or PINs.

question: Can the chat look like my business?
answer: Yes. In your dashboard, under Settings and Brand, you add your logo, a cover picture, your colour and a welcome line, and choose whether the chat shows Zaina's face or your logo. Your brand then appears on the chat, on your own page behind your QR code, and on the page where customers pay you.

question: Can I get business cards with my QR code?
answer: Yes, they come with every active Zaina plan. In your dashboard, under Settings and Business cards, choose one of three premium designs and the details you want on the card. Your brand goes on the front and your QR code on the back, so whoever you hand a card to can chat with Zaina day and night. Download a print-ready A4 sheet, a print shop file, or a picture to share on WhatsApp. If you'd rather we print them on premium card for you, ask from the same page and we'll give you a price before anything is printed.

question: Do you work in my town?
answer: Yes. We work with businesses all over Kenya, from Nairobi, Kisumu, Nakuru and Eldoret to the coast and smaller towns, and with clients abroad. Most set-ups are done remotely, so where you are makes no difference.

question: How does set-up work if I'm far away from you?
answer: It's done remotely. Tell us about your business, send your price list or menu (a photo is fine), your logo and the questions customers ask most, and we set everything up: your page and QR code in your brand, your menu or catalogue, and Zaina tuned to your business. You check it, we go live together, and you get print-ready QR posters, table cards and stickers for any local printer.

question: Which plan is right for my business?
answer: The Menu plan suits a restaurant, bar or hotel that wants a beautiful QR menu without the chat. Starter suits a business with many questions and leads but nothing to book online: Zaina answers, recommends and hands every lead to your team. Full suits a business that takes bookings, orders or deposits: Zaina checks what's free, quotes the exact total, books or takes the order and sends your own payment link. Tell me about your business and I'll say which fits.

question: What is the Menu plan?
answer: A branded QR menu for restaurants, bars and hotels: guests scan the code on the table and your menu opens in a moment, in your logo, colours and lettering, with today's special and tonight's event at the top and your M-Pesa till if you want it. Your team changes dishes and prices themselves, live at once, and the printed code never changes. It has no chat; you can add Zaina later on the same page.

question: How is your QR menu better than a PDF menu?
answer: A PDF has to download and then be pinched and zoomed. Our menu opens in a moment on any phone, is set in your own brand rather than a template, shows what's on where every guest looks first, can be searched, and changes the moment your team changes a price or marks a dish finished, so nothing is reprinted. You also see how many guests scan and open it.

question: Can I change my menu or prices myself?
answer: Yes, at any time, in your dashboard. You can also just tell the menu assistant in plain words, like "raise the cocktails by 10%" or "the tilapia is finished tonight": it shows every change before you apply it, and one tap undoes it. On Starter and Full, owners can also make changes from their own WhatsApp.

question: Can my M-Pesa till or Paybill show on my menu?
answer: Yes. The owner adds the till, or the Paybill and account number, in Settings and it shows on your page with a Copy button, and on your printed table cards if you like. Guests pay you directly; Zaina and Bila Matata never collect your money.

question: Will my page show up on Google and look good when shared on WhatsApp?
answer: Yes. Your page has its own address on bilamatata.com and is built so Google can read your business and your menu or price list. When it's shared on WhatsApp, Instagram or X it shows as a card with your photo or logo and your name, and there's a Share button on the page. Adding the link to your Google Business Profile and social media helps people find it.

question: Can Zaina take orders and arrange delivery?
answer: Yes, on the Full plan. She takes orders from your price list at the exact price, for delivery to your own delivery areas at your fees, or collection, holds the stock and passes the order to your team to accept. Customers can ask her later how their order is going. A guest who scans a table's code orders to that table.

question: Can I manage Zaina from my WhatsApp?
answer: Yes, on Starter and Full. The owner links their own number once, then messages changes like a colleague would ("mark the tilapia finished"). Zaina makes a change only after the owner replies YES.

question: Will I get reports?
answer: Yes. Your dashboard shows every chat, lead, booking and order, and on Starter and Full you get a monthly report by email: how many enquiries came in, what people asked about and what they led to.

question: Can Zaina send offers or reminders to my customers?
answer: Yes, if you turn them on: booking reminders, one gentle follow-up to someone who asked and didn't book, and a feedback request after a visit. Offers go only to customers who agreed to receive them, at most one a week, and anyone can reply STOP to stop messages.

question: Can Zaina work with my existing online shop or booking system?
answer: Yes. A shop on WooCommerce, Shopify or Google Merchant can have its catalogue read every day, prices and stock included. For other systems, Zaina can be connected so prices, stock and free dates come straight from it; that's quoted after a free look at what you use.

question: What kinds of businesses use Zaina?
answer: Any business that gets a lot of enquiries: hotels, lodges and villas; restaurants, bars and cafés; salons, spas and barbers; clinics; shops and online sellers; schools and training centres; property managers; and professional firms.

question: Is the Zaina on this website the same as the one I'd get?
answer: Yes. I'm Zaina, set up for Bila Matata the same way we set Zaina up for every business: I answer only from Bila Matata's own information and prices, recommend what suits you, and pass you to the team when you're ready. Yours would do the same for your customers, in your name and from your information.
